svg.aria-label: Disc displacement: with reduction and without reduction — 关节盘移位：可复性与不可复性

text.aria-label: Disc displacement: with reduction and without reduction — 关节盘移位：可复性与不可复性
text.tspan: Disc displacement: with reduction and without reduction
关节盘移位：可复性与不可复性

text.aria-label: Closed: the disc lies in front of the condyle — 闭口：关节盘位于髁突前方
text.tspan: Closed: the disc lies in front of the condyle
闭口：关节盘位于髁突前方

text.aria-label: Displaced disc — 移位的关节盘
Retrodiscal tissue under load — 盘后组织受压
Opening: the condyle slips back under the disc, with a click — 张口：髁突滑回关节盘下方，出现弹响
text.tspan: Opening: the condyle slips back under the disc, with a click
张口：髁突滑回关节盘下方，出现弹响

text.aria-label: Fully open: normal range — 完全张口：张口度正常
Without reduction (closed lock) — 不可复性移位（闭锁）
Closed: the disc lies in front of the condyle — 闭口：关节盘位于髁突前方
text.tspan: Closed: the disc lies in front of the condyle
闭口：关节盘位于髁突前方

text.aria-label: Opening: the disc stays in front and blocks the glide — 张口：关节盘留在前方，挡住滑动
text.tspan: Opening: the disc stays in front and blocks the glide
张口：关节盘留在前方，挡住滑动

svg.text: Opening is limited, typically to 30 mm or less when the lock is
recent. The chin deflects toward the affected side and stays
there. The earlier click has disappeared.
闭锁初期张口受限，通常不超过 30 mm。颏部偏向患侧且不回到中线。
With reduction: range is normal; the chin swings toward the
affected side until the click and then returns to the midline.
可复性移位：张口度正常；弹响之前颏部偏向患侧，弹响后回到中线。

text.aria-label: Blue band: articular disc. Pink: retrodiscal tissue. The joint is drawn as a schematic sagittal section, anterior to the right. — 蓝色带：关节盘。粉色：盘后组织。关节为矢状切面示意图，右侧为前方。
text.tspan: Blue band: articular disc. Pink: retrodiscal tissue. The joint is drawn as a schematic sagittal section, anterior to the right.
蓝色带：关节盘。粉色：盘后组织。关节为矢状切面示意图，右侧为前方。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
